name: Express
summary: A small JavaScript framework for building web servers and APIs on Node.js.

free_plan_covers.note: Free and open source under the MIT license. You pay only for hosting.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No paid plan. The framework itself is free.

portability.note: Runs anywhere Node.js runs, on your own server or any host.

language.note: Written in JavaScript. TypeScript also works with type definitions.

has_server_code.note: Route handlers run only on the server, so secrets stay private.

uses_react.note: Express is a server framework. Screens need templates or a separate frontend, which may or may not use React.

setup.step: Create the project with npm init, add Express with npm install express, and push it to a GitHub repository.

builder_notes: Read settings and secrets from process.env and never commit them.
Set NODE_ENV to production on the server; it makes Express faster and hides detailed errors.
